title.note: An outcome that is either true or not, not an activity

planned.note: The date in the plan, as '24 Mar'

projected.note: The date you now expect, same form. Equal to planned when nothing moved

slip.note: '+9 days', '-2 days', or empty when on plan

change.note: What changed since the last update, one sentence. Empty when nothing did

basis.note: How you know: who said it and when, or what you checked

selected_option.note: Id of the alternative the person chose. Only they set this

critical.note: True when a slip here moves the final date

title.note: What the milestone is waiting for, from someone else
A way to recover, as an action

effect.note: What it does to the date, as 'Launch 26 Mar (recovers 7 of 9 days)'

cost.note: What is given up or risked

fit.note: 1 to 5: how well it recovers the date for what it costs
